workflow_plan.goal: Calculate mean elevation for every census tract that intersects State College borough.

workflow_steps.title: Retrieve census tract polygons
workflow_steps.purpose: Obtain census tract polygons covering State College borough.
workflow_steps.instructions: Retrieve the highest-ranked census tract polygon dataset covering State College borough. Return the candidate for runtime inspection before spatial use.

workflow_steps.title: Combine DEM rasters
workflow_steps.purpose: Create one DEM covering the required analysis area from the two supplied complementary DEM rasters.
workflow_steps.instructions: Combine input_1 and input_2 into a single GeoTIFF DEM, preserving elevation values and avoiding duplicate contribution from overlapping cells. Do not proceed if runtime evidence shows incompatible grids or CRS.

workflow_steps.title: Identify tracts intersecting State College borough
workflow_steps.purpose: Select census tract features that intersect the supplied State College borough boundary.
workflow_steps.instructions: Perform a spatial join between census_tracts and input_3 using intersection, retaining the census tract features and their identifying attributes. Ground the tract identifier field from the retrieved dataset schema at runtime.

workflow_steps.title: Calculate mean elevation by tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Compute mean DEM elevation for each census tract that intersects State College borough.
workflow_steps.instructions: Calculate mean elevation from combined_dem for each polygon in intersecting_tracts. Preserve the grounded tract identifier in the CSV output and report one mean elevation per intersecting tract.

requirements.scope: The retrieved census tract candidate must cover State College borough.
input_1 and input_2 must have compatible grid definitions before raster calculation.

census_tracts and input_3 must have compatible CRS definitions for the spatial join.
